title: Join ALL Accor+ Explorer $369 for 1 Year, Get 3000 Bonus Points (Worth $95) @ Accor Plus
body:
Deal: Join ALL Accor+ Explorer $369 for 1 Year, Get 3000 Bonus Points (Worth $95) @ Accor Plus

[Oh Boy] I haven had Accor+, now explorer for almost 5 years, with the recent changes where 2 nights booking is required to get one free nights it's gotten a bit harder to get it over the weekend but I have had some great bargains. Recently started at Raffles in Asia almost getting $600 off one night, another in Fiji, got 800 off.
Takes a bit of work but there's good benefit to it.
[Yafuturefavorite] When they changed the membership to 2 nights and made changes to the 50% off dining, they lost a lot of people.
The membership just isn’t appealing with those changes.
Bring the old membership back and I’ll happily sign up again.
[JoelleP] They’ve managed to pick up plenty of new customers by dropping their prices and making the membership look like a better deal, but at the same time, they’re losing heaps of their old, loyal customers because the new membership just doesn’t stack up against what they had before. Honestly, I reckon one of the biggest reasons the business is going downhill is the inconsistent hotel pricing, dodgy advertising and misleading fine print. There are that many terms and conditions around using points, plus all sorts of hidden rules when booking hotels, that it’s becoming a real pain to deal with them. Their restaurant options are pretty limited too, and the quality isn’t anything special. Personally, I can’t stand dealing with companies that aren’t straight with their customers, and I reckon they’re one of them. They’re lucky to have a few absolute guns in their local outbound call centre who’ve been there for years. I know them well, as they’ve been renewing my membership for the past 17 years. But I wouldn’t be surprised if those jobs eventually disappear. A lot of those salespeople are getting closer to retirement, and it’d be a real shame to see good operators lose their jobs because of the way the business is being run. Anyway, best of luck to those good salespeople. They deserve better.
[nguyentran] Okay, So thought for this membership, when they convert my explorer+ they sent me an email telling me that my membership is expired at the end of the year, got email screenshot everything, later on after 7 months went by I realised that they kept my orginal expiration date which expired 31/07, I emailed them I havents used any bookings at all (Still 4 stay plus), they balantly denied that they was wrong, got all the email everything. after 2 weeks, some teams in the Malay call me and beg to renew, I told them honours my the date to end of year or extend to 1 months (till August so I can use the 4 days remaining) and I will renew for next year. Promise and and promise, end up contact some dude in India with the same responses. So if you need support, no nothing at all, sometimes I felt like I am being lied to but yeah. Be careful lads.
[Legsweeping] Adding to the horrible experiences caused by changing T&Cs midway through my membership and refusing to refund any of it despite greatly devaluing what I had paid for
[nguyentran] seems like i'm not the only one then hahaa
[nugstar] Ain't that basically illegal in Australia? Amazon getting sued for that with prime video ads.
[donman92] I literally booked 2 nights X 2 in the same cheapest possible hotel paying $67 per night (using the 2 buy one get one free nights) just in spite . It almost feels Illegal how they were able to rugpull the original deal After paying for membership. Probably the last time I'll ever get Accor membership and I hope we all vote with not only our wallets but reviews too.
[dandandan] Yes I have experienced issues others have, however they offered to refund in full if you didn't like/accept the new deal during the membership year affected, so it's only your own fault if you didn't take that offer up. Under the current deals/terms this is still better than IHG or Hilton offer so in my opinion a good deal for those that value hotel loyalty schemes.
[Billybob94111] I can only imagine how hard they must be bleeding after their most recent enshitification changes. It pleases me immensely to see everyone here rally against them.
I hope they fail. We all hope they fail. (profanity) them.
[Ozbogan69] If one claimed this purely at the same time as booking a fortnight at fiji nadi sofitel for 2 weeks in the coming 9 months would they benefit?
[DeepPocketsShortArms] I'll be cancelling my membership I've had for 5 years due to the enshitification.
I'll vote with my wallet.
